outcome: Delivery recommendations for healthy pregnant females with high-risk pathologies for rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD)
cohort: Canadian ophthalmologists, obstetrician-gynecologists, and their trainees
finding: Significantly more obstetrician-gynecologists than ophthalmologists recommended cesarean section for healthy pregnant females with previously treated retinal hole/tear or treated RRD.
mod_finding: Significantly more obstetrician-gynecologists recommended cesarean section for healthy pregnant females with previously treated retinal hole/tear or treated rhegmatogenous retinal detachment, while significantly more ophthalmologists recommended spontaneous vaginal delivery.
